lede: Pali, Shan And Burmese accounts for 63 catalogued manuscripts. It clusters in Mae Hong Son (95% of the corpus for this language), ahead of Wat Pang Mu and Nan. Nearly all (100%) are written in Shan · อักษรไทใหญ่ script. By support it leans to mulberry paper (saa) · กระดาษสา (98%) over khoi paper · กระดาษข่อย (2%). Dated witnesses run 1880–1989 CE (36 of 63 carry a date).

findings.title: Where three tongues share a page
findings.gloss: Manuscripts whose language is named as three or more tongues at once — Pali scripture threaded through Shan, Burmese, or Lao.
